item.title: MacJi 0.4.0
item.description:
Feedback from inside the app 💬
### Added - 💬 Send Feedback: Settings › About › Send Feedback… sends a bug, a feature idea or anything else by email (no account needed) or as a filled-in GitHub issue. Tick **Include technical details** to add only the MacJi and macOS versions and the Accessibility and Secure Input state; the form shows exactly what will be sent. - 📮 If your default email reader is a browser, or you have none, Send Email opens Gmail's compose page with the draft filled in. - 🌐 A feedback page on the website does the same without the app, with its own **Compose in Gmail** button, and replaces the website's "Report an issue" link. - 🙂 On that page a face made of dots wears the mood you pick, watches you type and winks when your draft opens. - 🌠 Type `::` or `##` anywhere on the website's home page to open the panel and stick your pick on the page.
### Changed - 👋 Quit MacJi in Settings is now a power icon in the About section. - 📝 Bug reports and feature requests on GitHub are now short forms that ask for what's needed. - 🔒 Security problems can also be reported privately by email, without a GitHub account.

item.title: MacJi 0.3.0
item.description:
Symbols, emoticons and your own aliases 🔣
### Added - 🔣 Symbol panel: type `##` and a word (`##arrow`, `##euro`, `##cmd`) for more than 2,000 Unicode symbols. Tab and Shift-Tab switch between categories. - 😄 Emoticons: start typing one (`^_`, `o_`) and MacJi suggests the rest, from more than 450 ASCII emoticons and kaomoji. Settings sets how many characters it waits for, or turns it off, and you can add a trigger to search emoticons by name. - ✍️ Aliases: `->` becomes →, `!=` ≠, `(c)` © as you type, in any app. Turn single aliases off, hide the ones you never want to see, and add your own with several spellings and outputs. Emoticon aliases such as `:)` → 🙂 start off; turn on the ones you want. - 🔎 Your aliases show first when you search any panel or the picker, by name. - 🧭 Emoji, Symbols and Emoticons tabs in the picker (⌘1–⌘3), each with its own recents. - 🌠 The panels list the glyphs you use most first.
### Changed - ⚙️ Open at login sits right under Accessibility in Settings; the rest of General is now Updates. - 🧹 With every typing feature off, MacJi stops watching the keyboard entirely.

item.title: MacJi 0.2.0
item.description: ### Added - ⚙️ Settings button in the emoji picker, beside the search field. - 👋 Quit MacJi button at the bottom of Settings.

item.title: MacJi 0.1.1
item.description:
The first release of MacJi 🎉 Emoji anywhere on your Mac, straight from the keyboard.
### Added - ⌨️ Inline panel: type `::` and a term in any app (`::rocket`) and pick an emoji under the caret. Return inserts it 🚀, Shift-Return copies it, Esc closes the panel. - 😀 Emoji picker in the menu bar with search, categories, recents and keyboard navigation. Return copies, Option-Return copies and keeps the picker open. - ⚡️ Global shortcut for the picker (default ⌃⌥⌘Space); it opens at the caret when the icon is hidden. - ⚙️ Settings: Accessibility status, shortcut, trigger, menu-bar icon, open at login, automatic updates. - 🔄 Automatic updates, signed with EdDSA so only genuine MacJi updates install.
### First launch - 🔐 MacJi isn't notarized: open it once from System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway, then turn on Accessibility for MacJi when it asks. - 💻 Needs macOS 14.6 or later.
